content.short: AnyAlt enables protocols to execute cross-chain and last-mile transactions with minimal code.
content.description: AnyAlt lowers friction for users, reduces fragmented liquidity, and simplifies the integration of fiat and crypto across multi-chain ecosystems. Its multi-chain routing engine streamlines cross-chain transactions, minimizes bridge-related failures, and removes the need for native gas tokens. By providing an SDK and a widget with pre-built templates, AnyAlt speeds up last-mile transactions and delivers direct crypto/fiat-to-protocol access, making onboarding easier for both developers and end users.

resources.title: Security Risks of Using Cross-Chain Bridges
resources.tldr: Works through why bridges keep getting drained, using real breaches rather than abstractions. The recurring theme is trusted validator sets rather than clever cryptography failing.

resources.title: What Is Cross-Chain and Multichain?
resources.tldr: The two terms get used interchangeably and mean quite different things: one moves value between chains, the other simply deploys in several places. Clears that up early.

resources.title: What Is Gas Refueling in Crypto?
resources.tldr: Arriving on a new chain holding tokens you cannot move is a genuinely common dead end. Explains the refuelling pattern that avoids it and where it can still fail.
